nodes.name: Every 06:00 and 18:00
nodes.notes: Runs in the workflow's timezone (Settings > Timezone, America/New_York), so DST is handled. Keep in step with the 06:00/18:00 slots in Run Context and in the Health Last Run workflow.

parameters.jsCode:
// Health triage settings. Everything the run decides from is here or in Alertmanager; edit and re-import.
const capabilities = {
  // id: [tier, impact shown in the message]
  'cp.api': ['H3', 'The Kubernetes API is unreliable, so deploys, controllers and kubectl fail.'],
  'cp.datastore': ['H3', 'The cluster datastore (etcd) is unhealthy, so the API can stall or lose quorum.'],
  'cp.scheduling': ['H3', 'Pods are not being scheduled or reconciled by controllers.'],
  'node.kubelet-runtime': ['H3', 'A node cannot run or restart its pods.'],
  'node.resources': ['H3', 'A node is under resource pressure, so pods get evicted or OOM-killed.'],
  'node.time-certs': ['H3', 'Node clock or certificates are off, so TLS and leases can fail.'],
  'node.disk': ['H2', 'A node disk is failing or erroring, so volumes and etcd on it are at risk.'],
  'node.fs': ['H2', 'A node filesystem is full or read-only.'],
  'node.net': ['H2', 'A node network link is down or flapping.'],
  'node.thermal-memory': ['H2', 'A node reports hardware errors (thermal, ECC or hung tasks).'],
  'nas.host': ['H1', 'The Synology NAS reports degraded storage, so NFS, S3 and backups on it are at risk.'],
  'dns.cluster': ['H3', 'In-cluster DNS fails, so most service-to-service calls fail.'],
  'net.pod': ['H3', 'Pod networking between nodes fails.'],
  'storage.block': ['H1', 'Longhorn block storage is degraded or unmonitored, so volumes may be at risk.'],
  'storage.nfs': ['H1', 'NFS storage is failing, so pods using it cannot read or write.'],
  'storage.object': ['H1', 'S3 object storage is failing, so backups and apps using it fail.'],
  'backup.volume': ['H1', 'Volume backups are failing or unverified, so data may not be restorable.'],
  'backup.db': ['H1', 'Postgres backups are missing or failing, so a database loss may not be recoverable.'],
  'gitops': ['H3', 'Flux is not reconciling, so Git changes are not reaching the cluster.'],
  'dns.home': ['M1', 'LAN DNS is failing, so devices on the network cannot resolve names.'],
  'net.lb': ['M1', 'LoadBalancer IPs are not announced, so services on them are unreachable.'],
  'net.http': ['M1', 'Ingress is failing, so web apps are unreachable.'],
  'net.policy': ['M1', 'NetworkPolicy enforcement is not working as intended.'],
  'net.wan': ['M1', 'The internet uplink is down or on backup.'],
  'net.lan': ['M1', 'A LAN device (switch, access point or gateway) is offline.'],
  'certs': ['M1', 'Certificates are not being issued or renewed, so TLS will start failing.'],
  'obs.metrics': ['M2', 'Metrics collection is degraded, so alert rules may not see problems.'],
  'obs.logs': ['M2', 'Log collection is degraded, so log-based alerts and investigation are blind.'],
  'obs.alerting': ['M2', 'Alert rules are not reaching Alertmanager.'],
  'triage.self': ['M2', 'The health check itself is failing.'],
  'secrets.sync': ['M3', 'Secrets are not syncing from Bitwarden, so new or rotated credentials do not arrive.'],
  'policy.admission': ['M3', 'The admission policy engine is failing, so deploys may be blocked or unchecked.'],
  'virt': ['M3', 'Virtual machines cannot run.'],
  'workload.batch': ['L', 'A scheduled job keeps failing.'],
};

return [{
  json: {
    alertmanager_url: 'http://kube-prometheus-stack-alertmanager.monitoring.svc.cluster.local:9093',
    page_base_url: 'https://n8n.${domain_name}/webhook/health',
    timezone: 'America/New_York',
    // Clusters whose Watchdog must be present for the run to trust the snapshot.
    watchdog_clusters: ['homelab'],
    // Heartbeats that must be present. Heartbeats seen in the previous run are also expected, so a
    // rule file added later is covered from its first run without editing this list. nas entries
    // belong here once nas rules are evaluated centrally (VictoriaMetrics migration).
    expected_heartbeats: [
      'homelab/backup.db', 'homelab/cp.api', 'homelab/cp.datastore', 'homelab/cp.scheduling',
      'homelab/dns.cluster', 'homelab/gitops', 'homelab/nas.host', 'homelab/net.lan', 'homelab/net.wan',
      'homelab/node.disk', 'homelab/node.kubelet-runtime', 'homelab/node.net', 'homelab/node.resources',
      'homelab/node.thermal-memory', 'homelab/node.time-certs', 'homelab/obs.logs', 'homelab/obs.metrics',
      'homelab/storage.block', 'homelab/workload.batch',
    ],
    capabilities,
    // Upstream -> downstream (design dependency graph). A firing upstream absorbs its downstream issues.
    dependencies: {
      'nas.host': ['storage.nfs', 'storage.object'],
      'node.disk': ['storage.block', 'cp.datastore'],
      'node.net': ['net.pod', 'net.lb'],
      'cp.datastore': ['cp.api'],
      'cp.api': ['gitops', 'secrets.sync', 'cp.scheduling'],
      'net.pod': ['dns.cluster'],
      'dns.cluster': ['net.http', 'backup.db', 'backup.volume'],
      'net.lb': ['net.http', 'dns.home'],
      'certs': ['net.http'],
      'storage.object': ['backup.db', 'backup.volume'],
      'storage.block': ['backup.volume'],
      'secrets.sync': ['storage.object'],
      'obs.metrics': ['obs.alerting'],
      'policy.admission': ['cp.api'],
    },
    // Used only for alerts without capability/tier labels (upstream chart rules).
    alertname_overrides: [
      ['^CNPG', 'backup.db', 'H1'],
      ['^KubeVirt', 'virt', 'M3'],
      ['^(Node|Smart)', 'node.disk', 'H2'],
      ['^KubeNode', 'node.kubelet-runtime', 'H3'],
      ['^Etcd|^etcd', 'cp.datastore', 'H3'],
    ],
    namespaces: {
      'longhorn-system': ['storage.block', 'H1'], 'csi-driver-nfs': ['storage.nfs', 'H1'],
      'minio': ['storage.object', 'H1'], 'versitygw': ['storage.object', 'H1'], 'garage': ['storage.object', 'H1'],
      'cnpg-system': ['backup.db', 'H1'],
      'kube-system': ['cp.api', 'H3'], 'flux-system': ['gitops', 'H3'], 'system-upgrade': ['cp.api', 'H3'],
      'traefik': ['net.http', 'M1'], 'metallb-system': ['net.lb', 'M1'], 'external-dns': ['dns.home', 'M1'],
      'dns': ['dns.home', 'M1'], 'tailscale': ['net.http', 'M1'], 'cert-manager': ['certs', 'M1'],
      'monitoring': ['obs.metrics', 'M2'], 'logging': ['obs.logs', 'M2'],
      'external-secrets': ['secrets.sync', 'M3'], 'kyverno': ['policy.admission', 'M3'],
      'kubevirt': ['virt', 'M3'], 'authentik': ['', 'M3'], 'stakater-reloader': ['', 'M3'],
    },
    // Messages list at most this many items; the rest are on the index page.
    max_items: 6,
    // A recurring issue is announced on its first few recurrences only.
    max_reopen_notifications: 3,
  },
}];

nodes.name: Settings
nodes.notes: Alertmanager URL, page URL, capability catalog, expected heartbeats, dependency graph and tier maps.

nodes.name: Alertmanager
nodes.notes: Silenced and inhibited alerts are included on purpose: Evaluate uses them to mark issues accepted and to see heartbeats. A failed read becomes the 'alert pipeline blind' issue.

nodes.name: Evaluate
nodes.notes: Every decision (fingerprint, tier, state, dependency collapse, notify gate, message) is made here, deterministically.

parameters.jsCode:
const rows = $('Evaluate').first().json.issueRows;
return rows.length ? rows.map((json) => ({ json })) : [{ json: { fingerprint: '' } }];

const rows = $('Evaluate').first().json.events;
return rows.length ? rows.map((json) => ({ json })) : [{ json: { fingerprint: '' } }];

nodes.notes: finished_at is the liveness signal the Health Last Run endpoint reports on. Any earlier failure leaves it empty.
